findings.title: Core page content is heavily dependent on client-side rendering
findings.evidence: The homepage, /pricing, and /discover each returned HTTP 200 but only 12 raw-text words. Browser inspection after JavaScript execution showed the homepage rendering its product description, feature sections, creator profile, and 24 links, confirming that core content is absent from the initial HTML.

suggested_action.summary: Server-render or statically emit the primary product and profile content in the initial HTML.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Render the page title, value proposition, feature descriptions, key profile content, and important links on the server or at build time, while retaining client-side hydration for interactivity. Recheck raw HTML word count and crawler extraction after deployment.

findings.title: Pricing page has no Product or Offer structured data
findings.evidence: https://linkitapp.in/pricing contains two valid JSON-LD blocks, but browser inspection and the scan found only WebSite and Organization types. The rendered page exposes the transactional claim 'Rs 0 forever' and a Free Forever plan without Product, Offer, price, or priceCurrency markup.

suggested_action.summary: Add Product and Offer JSON-LD for the Free Forever plan.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a Product entity for Linkit and an Offer with price 0, the correct priceCurrency, availability, and a stable pricing URL. Keep the same facts visible in HTML and ensure the JSON-LD is present before hydration.

findings.title: Linkit has a high-risk name collision with adjacent products
findings.evidence: A Bing search for 'Linkit linkitapp.in Hardik Gupta' returned Linkit's own result alongside unrelated Linkit entities including linkit.co, linkitapp.app, linkitdev.com, and linkitnow.in; linkitnow.in is also a creator link-in-bio product. Linkit's Organization JSON-LD identifies the founder and support email but contains no sameAs, alternateName, or geographic/industry disambiguating marker.

suggested_action.summary: Add machine-readable identity links and a distinctive category marker to Linkit's Organization schema.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add sameAs links to the official founder/company profiles, use an alternateName such as 'Linkit by Hardik Gupta' where accurate, and include a clear industry/category and location marker. Use the same wording in the About and Contact pages.

findings.title: Core product and pricing claims have little independent corroboration
findings.evidence: The site claims a link-in-bio platform with portfolio mode, AI visitor chatbot, analytics, storefront tools, and Free Forever pricing. In the live Bing search, independent results included founder LinkedIn posts and a Peerlist founder profile, but no independent result confirmed the full product feature set or the Free Forever pricing claim; the detailed claims remain supported primarily by linkitapp.in itself.

suggested_action.summary: Build independent references for Linkit's identity, feature set, and pricing model.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Secure accurate third-party listings or coverage that name Linkit, its canonical domain, founder, category, and major features. Keep those profiles current and link them from the site's Organization sameAs property.

proactive_recommendations.title: Expose a compact product summary in initial HTML
proactive_recommendations.rationale: The site already has strong visible product messaging and an llms.txt file, but crawlers that do not execute JavaScript see almost none of that context.

suggested_action.summary: Place a concise server-rendered summary of Linkit's audience, category, and flagship features in the page source.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Include a short semantic paragraph and a small list of core features in the initial HTML, then hydrate the richer interactive layout around it.

proactive_recommendations.title: Add a first-party changelog and FAQ knowledge layer
proactive_recommendations.rationale: The site has Releases and support-oriented product claims in llms.txt; turning common questions into crawlable FAQ content would improve answerability for feature, pricing, and setup queries.

suggested_action.summary: Publish crawlable FAQs for pricing, setup, privacy, and feature boundaries, with FAQPage markup where eligible.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Link the FAQ and dated release entries from the homepage, keep answers in HTML, and add valid FAQPage or Article structured data only where the visible content qualifies.
